name: Sakagami Kotono
source:
A fellow tenet in the protagonist's apartment. Ever since childhood, she was a friend and pseudo-sister to the protagonist. She doesn't see him as a man since she saw him grew up but is still friendly to him.

Due to this, she is trusting of the protagonist and often invites him for drinks.
